cluster_label: Authorized Economic Operator (Recognition and Management) Rules 2024
title: AEO Status Management and Compliance Enforcement
summary: The evolution of AEO status management centers on the formalization of procedural interactions between the AEO Center and operators. Initially focused on application and basic suspension, the framework expanded to include specific mechanisms for status advancement, rejection, and the remediation of compliance deficiencies.

evolution.procedural_depth: Shifted from general application handling to granular management of status advancement, rejection, and disciplinary restoration.
evolution.compliance_framework: Expanded from basic recognition to active monitoring of Class-1 compliance and remediation timelines.

timeline.instrument: Authorized Economic Operator (Recognition and Management) Rules 2024
timeline.change: Initial establishment of application, Tier-3 advancement, suspension, and extension procedures.
Introduction of specific compliance obligations for Class-1 institutions and standardized document processing templates.

timeline.instrument: Authorized Economic Operator (Recognition and Management) Rules 2024
timeline.change: Formalization of rejection protocols for status advancement and detailed procedures for certificate cancellation or restoration.

Authorized Economic Operator: This clause provides the formal application format (Form-T) for entities currently holding Tier-2 status to upgrade their certification to Tier-3 status.

Applicants must demonstrate a history of operations under Tier-2 status and provide evidence of a satisfactory audit as required by the Authorized Economic Operator (Recognition and Management) Rules, 2024.
The application process requires submitting the organization's name, address, Business Identification Number, details of the existing Tier-2 certificate, and the date of the most recent audit.
Business Identification Number: The Business Identification Number is a mandatory detail required to be submitted by an applicant seeking to upgrade to Tier-3 Authorized Economic Operator status.
Authorized Economic Operator (Recognitio: These rules establish the legal framework under which an entity may apply for and be granted Tier-3 Authorized Economic Operator status.
Rule 9(2) specifically outlines the provision for applying for Tier-3 recognition, while Rule 8(1) governs the operational duration requirement for existing Tier-2 status holders.
